svg.aria-label: Refract pack matrix: twenty-three role-based packs and the agents, skills, commands and rules each contributes
svg.title: Refract pack matrix: twenty-three role-based packs and the agents, skills, commands and rules each contributes
svg.desc: File counts measured on disk for each pack's agents, skills, commands and rules. Totals: 86 agents, 114 skills, 133 pack commands, 28 rules.
svg.text: Work is organised by role, not by framework — one api-architect works for every backend. /setup-project selects packs
from detection signals; four are applied to every project regardless.
Building LLM/AI features well — RAG, evals, prompts, agents, LLM gateway…
Algorithm design + complexity analysis — pick the structure for the input…
Codebase quality gate — 12 universal detectors against the gold-standard…
Warehouse + analytics engineering — declared grain, layered…
Cost as a reviewed engineering dimension — unit economics, spend…
Per-feature V1→V2 port with parity guarantees + migration-time perf uplift
Decide what to build and why — evidence-labelled problem framing…
23 packs · 104 ai-patterns and 31 framework references not counted
Generated by scripts/gen-pack-matrix.py — {agents,commands,rules}/*.md per pack; skills are skills/<name>/SKILL.md. Bars scale per column, not across columns.
Always applied — added to selected_tracks even when no detection signal fires: code-quality, documentation, learning, security.
The 15 global commands in commands/ belong to no pack: 133 pack + 15 global = 148. Domain and repo-baseline commands are counted in docs/CHEATSHEET.md,
not here. Always-applied flags and summaries come from templates/packs/_registry.md; a pack with no row falls back to its _essentials.md heading.
